claim: The one-click sample uses separate demo storage and does not change real working data.
sandbox: Seed real local storage, open /demo, edit and reset the sample, then assert only demo: storage changed.

claim: Creates editable scripts from Markdown, LaTeX, MathML, code, tables, and figures.
sandbox: Clean /demo; build a mixed technical article and edit a generated phrase.

claim: Repeats the same suggestion for the same source and flags ambiguous notation for review.
sandbox: Clean /demo; build an equation with vertical bars twice and compare the suggested phrase and proofing note.

claim: Records approval and marks an approved script segment revised after editing.
sandbox: Clean /demo; approve a generated heading, edit its narration, and observe the revised state.

claim: Downloads review scripts as plain text and Markdown.
sandbox: Clean /demo; download both formats and inspect their names and checklist content.

claim: Keeps the demo working copy after reload without using real working storage.
sandbox: Clean /demo; build a changed sample, reload, and inspect local-storage namespaces.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for service-worker control, go offline, then reload the page.

claim: The app does not send entered article text over the network.
sandbox: Clean /demo; record all browser requests while entering and building private source text.

claim: Visitors can create a sample script without an account.
sandbox: Clean /demo; open and use the populated script without sign-in controls.

claim: Creates a downloadable script, not synthetic audio.
sandbox: Clean /demo; verify the text export and absence of an audio or video player.

claim: Uses no third-party runtime assets or tracking.
sandbox: Clean /demo; capture runtime request origins through a sample export.

claim: Keeps raw article HTML as text instead of running it.
sandbox: Clean /demo; build a source string with an image onerror handler and assert it stays text and never runs.
